$ mail-find
exit 0
--- stdout
Search, read and download from mail history. Nothing here sends or changes mail.

Output is JSON; --text gives the human form. Every result's next_steps are
runnable commands for what was seen but not done. ID is the "id" field of a
search hit; a Message-ID (the RFC 822 header, or a message:// link) goes to
resolve first.

Usage:
  mail-find [command]

Available Commands:
  attachments list a message's attachments
  auth        sign in and check credentials
  context     messages about the same real-world thing, across threads and senders (heuristic; each hit says why)
  fetch       download attachments to a local directory
  help        Help about any command
  read        full message: headers, body, attachment manifest
  resolve     find a message from a Message-ID or a message:// URL dragged out of a mail client
  search      search mail history in the portable grammar
  thread      every message the provider grouped with this one, as one transcript

Flags:
      --account string   which account: gmail|outlook (default "gmail")
  -h, --help             help for mail-find
      --text             human-readable output instead of JSON

Use "mail-find [command] --help" for more information about a command.
--- stderr
